summary: Iter 88 — Family tab (prayers/saint/devotion/question/coloring), Coloring pages, and children's book covers all verified end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passed against public prod URL (family/today schema+i18n, 6 coloring pages with data-URL line-art, 3 children books with data-URL cover_image). Frontend: Family screen renders all 6 testIDs (reminders, saint-spotlight, devotional, question, coloring, plus morning/night prayer cards); tapping Saint Spotlight expands bio (114→341 chars, St. Anthony of Padua verified); reminders button opens 'Not available here' web alert without crashing; family-coloring navigates to /coloring which shows all 6 tiles (cross, chalice-host, nativity, guardian-angel, holy-spirit-dove, sacred-heart); tapping cross tile opens /coloring/cross canvas with 10-color palette, undo, clear, and line-art image rendering; Library Books tab shows all 3 children book cards (bible-stories-for-little-souls, little-saints-for-little-hearts, the-holy-mass-for-little-ones) with illustrated JPEG cover images replacing the icon. Freehand drawing (PanResponder) not exercised — as requested, only canvas/palette/line-art render was verified.
